g.text: available = units > 0; zero current units means unavailable.
Inactive sellable Product stays in the catalogue with available=false.
Compare units with this size's StockUnitsConsumed; any shortage makes this size unavailable.
Size is unavailable if Product/size is inactive or any required stock is insufficient.
Pizza available = Product is active and at least one included size is available.
